final: WITH linked AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, `aCL IgM` - (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM linked) AS deviation FROM linked), scored AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.`aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - (SELECT AVG(d2.deviation) FROM deviations AS d2 WHERE d2.SEX = d.SEX) AS excess FROM deviations AS d) SELECT ID, SEX, `aCL IgM`, deviation, excess FROM scored WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10
